style: soft, colorful preschool clay-style 3D animation; gentle expressions and rounded child-friendly shapes

Leo.face: soft rounded muzzle, large kind brown eyes
Leo.continuity_rule: Keep the same face, fur color, proportions, and bright red vest in every scene.

Mimi.face: large kind eyes and long soft ears
Mimi.signature_outfit: pink dress and matching pink bow
Mimi.continuity_rule: Keep the same face, white fur, proportions, pink dress, and matching pink bow in every scene.

Bobo.features: rounded body and short curved trunk
Bobo.continuity_rule: Keep the same blue color, rounded proportions, and short curved trunk in every scene.

global_rules: Do not redesign characters between scenes.
Do not change signature clothing or accessories.
Use gentle, safe, age-appropriate actions for preschool children.
Avoid scary expressions, violence, dangerous imitation, flashing lights, and text embedded in generated frames.
